items.subject: The knowledge store's nightly pass went RED
evidence: C:\Users\Owner\.claude\recall-sleep-latest.md:47-51 'gate (exit 1): BROKEN' with why: 'recall_append.py FAIL exit 1 APPEND-SELFTEST-COMPLETE'; 'C--Codex-ThriftyCrew: memory NO_COST rose to 152 against a mark of 151'; 'MEMORY.md links 1 file(s) git does not track (write-tool-decodes-backslash-u-escapes.md)'
:45-46 forgetting and memory clusters exit 1 'waiting on a judgement' (Q-recall-judgement-queues, already Brad's)
items.root_cause: The knowledge store's only defence against a bad write was the NEXT night's gate: a memory written through a shell command skipped the Write|Edit lint entirely, and nothing at write time checked that MEMORY.md points only at committed files or that a new memory's [[links]] resolve, so every such write surfaced 04:35 the following night as a RED pass (14 of 30 nights; the untracked-index-link reason on 6 of the last 7 RED nights). Separately, a flaky self-test (a single read of a freshly renamed file on Windows) could turn the gate RED with no defect at all.

root_fix.what: move the three store-shape checks the gate kept discovering to the moment of the write, and make the flaky self-test deterministic
root_fix.exact_change: recall-memory-lint-hook.py: (a) a MEMORY.md Write/Edit that ADDS a link to a file git does not track or that is not on disk is DENIED with the pathspec commit command; (b) a NEW memory with a [[link]] naming no memory in its store is DENIED (same matching as check-skills.dangling_links); (c) registered on PostToolUse Bash|PowerShell: a shell command naming a memory path BLOCKS with the reason when that memory is untracked and structurally defective or dangling, or when it is MEMORY.md with an untracked link. All fail open when git cannot answer. recall_append.spawn_lock_holder retries the ready-file read until the word arrives, the child dies or the 60 s hang guard ends, and reports which; the case still demands holder == held. recall_floors.derive: when the at-or-under-target side of a tie jump is below RATE_BAND and the other side is inside it, take the in-band side.

items.root_cause: No check compares what a LIVE page says with the data it was built from after the run that published it. The deferred post counts only for its own date and only for the run's own push, so a held commit that lands on a later push leaves the post naming a board the feed no longer serves; a companion page (tracker) publisher failure prints only inside publish-deals-page's filtered output. Both were silent for days.
items.resolution_note: Root fix for the class: grocery/audit-live-page-parity.ps1 reads the LIVE board post and /omaha-price-tracker/ on every capture-run, after the post decision, and pages 'Grocery page does not match its shipped data' when the post names a board the feed no longer serves or the tracker quotes a week other than its built page, so shipped data and a published page can no longer diverge silently. Founding cases were live on 2026-09-26 (post v=780837d352 over served a14a8c805c since 09-24; tracker Sep 2 vs Sep 22) and both fire. Hand repair of a late-landed held post is owned by 2026-09-26-518fff. Pulled forward and closes 2026-09-25-22b1e8.
items.premise_verified: false as planned: the plan carried this as a 7-call re-check ('today's publish was held by guards, not soundness'). Re-measured live 2026-09-26 10:40: the class REPRODUCES. /omaha-grocery-prices/ names board.json?v=780837d352 (Ghost article:modified_time 2026-09-23T05:20Z) while feed.thriftycrew.com serves a14a8c805c (= public/board.json at 64fb5fb6a and e90682129, the 2026-09-24 daily). capture-run-daily-2026-09-24.log:374-378: the run committed locally, the tail sync blocked the push, 'POST HELD' (pages nothing); the commit landed on a later push and nothing republished. /omaha-price-tracker/ quotes 'week of Sep 2, 2026' (modified 2026-09-05) against a built out/trend/index.html of 'week of Sep 22, 2026'.
items.deviation: Built the class fix instead of a re-check close: the soundness-hold root fix (742445437) and a84dcf's by-design close stand, but every check judged a publish from INSIDE the run that made it, so a page left behind by any other road (late-landed commit, expired deferral, a companion publisher's filtered failure) was silent. New grocery/audit-live-page-parity.ps1 reads the LIVE pages from outside and capture-run runs it every run after the post decision. Pulled 2026-09-25-22b1e8 forward: its tracker arm is the same class.

root_fix.what: grocery/audit-live-page-parity.ps1: board-post arm (live post board.json?v= vs SHA-1 of the served board, reusing Test-TcBoardServed) and tracker arm (live vs built 'week of' label), up to 3 reads a minute apart, exit 0/2/3 with LIVE-PAGE-PARITY-COMPLETE. capture-run runs it every run after Get-DeferredPostDecision and pages 'Grocery page does not match its shipped data' (page, condition 1), not twice when the run already paged the same failed publish; a blind read queues and mails on the 2nd sighting (hold_observations 2) without failing the run.

proof.must_fire_case: frozen live post naming v=780837d352 against served stand-in bytes -> diverged naming both versions; frozen tracker 'week of Sep 2, 2026' vs built 'week of Sep 22, 2026' -> diverged, 20 days apart; persistent divergence over 3 reads -> diverged; blind halves (unreadable feed, no version, no/two week labels, missing built page, throwing fetch) -> blind, never parity. LIVE: audit-live-page-parity.ps1 rc=2, both arms DIVERGED on the real pages.
proof.clean_twin: live post naming the served board -> parity; live tracker quoting the built week -> parity; a Ghost cache lag clearing on read 2 -> parity after one wait; both arms parity -> exit 0; capture-run calls the audit after the deferred-post decision and pages under the registered subject.
